503.description: The hosted issuer trust set is unavailable or invalid

get.summary: Get the hosted license issuer trust set
get.description: Returns one current and optionally one NEXT Ed25519 key in that order. keyId is lowercase SHA-256 hex of canonical SPKI DER; jwtKid preserves the existing first-eight-hex SHA-256 of normalized PEM. digest is lowercase SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 compact JSON with property order {version,issuer,audience,keys}, where each ordered key is {role,algorithm,keyId}. Clients must fetch this fixed-origin HTTPS endpoint without redirects and reject an unavailable or malformed trust set. The legacy publicKey property mirrors the current key for compatibility.
